request.query: An element in the ideal span of finite generators is a sum of scalar multiples

items.name: Ideal.mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : Fintype α] {x : R} {v : α → R},
  x ∈ Ideal.span (Set.range v) ↔ ∃ c, ∑ i, c i * v i = x

items.name: Submodule.mem_span_iff_exists_finset_subset
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_2 : Module R M] {s : Set M}
  {x : M}, x ∈ Submodule.span R s ↔ ∃ f t, ↑t ⊆ s ∧ Function.support f ⊆ ↑t ∧ ∑ a ∈ t, f a • a = x

items.name: Submodule.mem_span_iff_of_fintype
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_2 : Module R M] {s : Set M}
  [inst_3 : Fintype ↑s] {x : M}, x ∈ Submodule.span R s ↔ ∃ f, ∑ a, f a • ↑a = x

items.name: Span.repr_def
items.type:
∀ (R : Type u_4) {M : Type u_5} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_2 : Module R M] (w : Set M)
  (x : ↥(Submodule.span R w)), Span.repr R w x = ⋯.choose

items.name: Submodule.mem_ideal_smul_span_iff_exists_sum
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {M : Type v} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_2 : Module R M] (I : Ideal R)
  [I.IsTwoSided] {ι : Type u_4} (f : ι → M) (x : M),
  x ∈ I • Submodule.span R (Set.range f) ↔ ∃ a, ∃ (_ : ∀ (i : ι), a i ∈ I), (a.sum fun i c => c • f i) = x
